description: This file auto-discovers and loads example datasets from Parquet files for the Superset project, including functions to read dataset configurations and dynamically create dataset loaders.

methods.name: get_dataset_config_from_yaml
methods.description: Reads dataset configuration from dataset.yaml if it exists.

methods.name: get_examples_directory
methods.description: Returns the path to the examples directory.

methods.name: _get_multi_dataset_config
methods.description: Reads configuration for multi-dataset examples from datasets/{name}.yaml.

methods.name: discover_datasets
methods.description: Auto-discovers dataset files and creates loaders for them.
